claim: With auto-enrollment on, moving an account into a registered OU enrolls it with that OU's baseline and controls, for existing and newly created accounts; moving it to an unregistered OU or the root unenrolls it and Control Tower removes the baseline resources and controls.
question: How do accounts enter and leave Control Tower governance with auto-enrollment?

values.display: The account automatically receives baseline resources and controls
Move the account to an OU that is not registered
removes all deployed baseline resources and controls automatically

qualifiers.condition: auto-enrollment enabled; landing zone 3.1 or later

evidence.quote: The account automatically receives baseline resources and controls from that OU. This applies to both existing accounts and newly created accounts (which are created in the organization root by default).

To unenroll an account: Move the account to an OU that is not registered with AWS Control Tower, or to the root of the organization. AWS Control Tower removes all deployed baseline resources and controls automatically.
